note: MIN-F underground works (Mining spec stage 4 and 5, phase F; docs/build17/MIN_F_UNDERGROUND.md) and MIN-F2 (the owner's MIN-F-Q1..Q5 decisions, docs/directives/2026-10-21_build17_minf_q1_q5_decisions.md; docs/build17/MIN_F2_STRUCTURE.md), read by MineWorks (game/scripts/core/mine_works.gd). Cutting: each rock cell holds the finite units of `cell` (top of the list first), cut one unit at a time with a pickaxe, counted cut_<item>; the last opens the cell. Only rock under the hill's static rock with rock all round may be cut, never a seam's cell, only from an open face, and only within `support.reach` of a standing timber support. Q1 stability (`stability`): every cell opened by the works (and every shaft) is evaluated once a day at dawn from its own surroundings: each standing support within `support.reach` adds condition/1000 x `near_weight` (at most a cell away) or `far_weight`, each 4-neighbouring cell holding backfill adds `backfill_weight` x its fill share, the backfill part capped at `backfill_cap` (below `threshold`: backfill alone never makes a cell safe, and it never mends timber); a cell under `threshold` collapses that day when a per-cell, per-day hash of the world seed (0..999) is under (threshold - stability) x `rate` x 1000. A collapse refills the cell with rubble: the roof rock fallen in, all of it spoil (`cell` units less any fill), dug out again as spoil (never stone or ore); whoever stands there steps to the nearest floor, a support on the cell is crushed, track under it stays. Supports and ladders lose `decay_per_day` of their 1000 condition every dawn (a support at 0 has failed and is gone; a ladder at 0 has broken and the shaft cannot be climbed); a repair with a mallet uses `support.repair` or `ladder.repair` goods and restores the full condition. Q4 shafts (`shaft`): a shaft is sunk from a floor cell of one level through `shaft.units` (top first) to the level below; the cell above becomes the shaft's mouth (not walkable); the landing below opens as floor (a rock landing is cut as an ordinary cell, `cell` units more). A shaft needs a rock face beside its landing for the ladder, a support within reach, may not cut its level in two, and goes no deeper than `shaft.deepest`; a level below the cave is made when the first shaft reaches it (all rock but the landing, hidden ore by the same generator). A ladder (`ladder.item`) set into a finished shaft with a mallet makes it a portal the level router uses; goods go up and down only in a climber's hands (no hoist): a minecart never goes through a shaft. Q5 backfill (`backfill`): spoil is put back into a floor cell below ground one unit at a time (`backfill.minutes` a unit for a villager), counted filled_spoil, up to `cell` units: full, the cell is solid; dug again, the fill comes back as spoil. Only the player starts it: the player's own hands, or an order the player pays for (`backfill.order_rate` coins a unit, held until done) that the village's workers may take through the manor's job board, carrying the spoil the player leaves at the order's depot (the mouth's surface stand) down to the cell in loads of carry_ore. Q3 (`minecart`): a minecart holds at most `minecart.capacity` units; a miner below ground with a full load loads it into a usable minecart of their household parked on track near the seam instead of carrying out when the cart's way is cheaper (MIN_F2_STRUCTURE.md), and hauls when it holds `minecart.trip` units. MIN-COLLAPSE (`collapse`, owner MIN-F2-Q2: survive or die in Build 17, no injury): a person on a cell as it caves in survives when a hash of the seed, the day, the cell and the person (0..999) is under survive_base + survive_per_held x the cell's stability as it fell (0.0 to 0.5 below the threshold: 300 to 600 per mille): a TEMPORARY TUNABLE for the owner's review, not policy. MIN-EQUIP (`supply`): the manor repairs a support worn below repair_at of its condition that holds an opened cell (MineSupply). Every number is an agent decision (a balance parameter to tune by testing), not owner policy.
